dcp.name: City of Canada Bay DCP (Amendment 14), Part E

front.note: C1 (p E-18): minimum 4.5m or no less than the Prevailing Street Setback (average of five adjoining residential properties on both sides), whichever is greater. DCP notes many setbacks are 7.5m or more.

secondaryFront.note: C7 (p E-19): secondary street setback minimum 2m for the first 25m from the corner; prevailing secondary street setback applies from 25m to rear boundary (C9).

side.note: C10 (p E-19): single storey 900mm; second storey of all dwellings 1500mm.

rear.note: C11 (p E-22): minimum rear setback 6.0m; C12: living room on upper floor minimum rear setback 9.0m.

garage.note: No garage setback in E4.2. E2.1 C3 (p E-3): attached garage must not be located within the primary facade. Part B3.2 C4 (p B-14): 'distance between the front property boundary and building is to be a minimum of 5.5m' for hardstands.
